title: Static Strike Assassin
overview:
Level with a claw attack and switch to Static Strike of Gathering Lightning once you have the transfigured gem and a suitable elemental claw.

Build reference by Zish. Original guide: https://pobarchives.com/build/eLPCznfe
Original PoB: https://pobb.in/K_mS_CBHgnGn

Campaign items illustrate equipment progression. Use linked campaign drops you can equip. Some utility groups in campaign sets become available in later acts. Check gem requirements and combat assumptions before purchasing gear. Set the character level when you switch loadouts.

stages.title: Act 1 · Claw leveling
stages.goal: Use Frost Blades or Cobra Lash from the campaign skill set.
stages.priority: Buy and link the skill for your weapon.

stages.title: Campaign · Claw progression
stages.goal: Follow the act-by-act gem groups in Skills and continue leveling on a claw attack.
stages.priority: Prepare the transfigured gem and an elemental claw.

stages.title: Atlas · Static Strike swap
stages.goal: Swap to Static Strike of Gathering Lightning with a compatible claw and supports.
stages.priority: Verify Trinity resonance and your defences before the switch.

stages.title: Endgame · Week-one map setup
stages.goal: Follow the week-one set and keep a separate single-target setup where applicable.
stages.priority: Get a better elemental claw and finish defensive affixes.

stages.title: Endgame · Higher investment
stages.goal: Use the final elemental claw setup.
stages.priority: Compare optional upgrades in desktop PoB.
